svg.title: The package service attempts an outward fetch
svg.desc: Retain the missing document and aim a route from the permitted service toward it. Keep this an attempted fetch, with no returned data or success mark. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.

**Frame:** The environment inventory from [page 017](017.md) narrows to Artifactory. A simple arrow aims from the package service toward the inaccessible external material.

**Action:** The agent tests whether the service can fetch beyond the sandbox.

**Caption:**
> ONE AVAILABLE SERVICE CAN MAKE REQUESTS OF ITS OWN.
